Place your bets… tonight is going to be special!

After so many years of classes, friends, laughter and stories, it is time to celebrate.

From the tenth grade, we want to invite you to a night of music, dancing, photos and lots of fun, because a class like yours deserves a send-off in grand style.

Put on your best looks, bring all the attitude and get ready for a night you will remember for a long time.

The dice are rolled. See you at the table.
